comment: The pattern, arpeggio and length inputs are cast to an unsigned integer before they are clamped (ArpeggiatorMkII.cpp:598, 604 and 610), so a negative voltage does not read as zero: it wraps to a very large number and the clamp then pins it to the last setting in the list. Send only positive voltages to those jacks.
